name: Protect
doc: Protect (spell; the act family, Drain's master without actor pools): once its children are gone the stage wobble in, then one emitter per action - its sound, a screen flash, the shield model played on the target, particles thrown out, the master's release, the result; after the last action a wait, the stage wobble out. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag032_protect.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone; the stage in task; after the last action its wait, the stage out task

pools.doc: the particle spawner and particles (the port's)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the screen flash, the shield, the particle spawner, the master's release, the result; the master's wait

parts.title: Stage wobble
parts.doc: The stage wobble in (once the master's children are gone) and out (after the wait)

groups.label: Particles
groups.doc: The particle spawner throws particles from this tick until this one (its count table a tick: 20..24)

params.label: Flash tick
params.doc: The screen flash at this tick

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Result tick
params.doc: The action's result from this tick

params.label: Wait
params.doc: After the last action, the wobble out after these ticks

params.label: Level
params.doc: Its amplitude (in: up to it, out: from it)

params.label: Step
params.doc: Up / down by this a tick

params.label: Flipbook 15F8C64
params.doc: The sprite sequence at 0x15F8C64 (a flipbook of 12 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sound, the screen flash, the shield player, the particle spawner, the master's release, the result.
The stage wobble in (the port's task: the four stage wobble words up a step a tick).
The stage wobble out (the port's task: from its level down a step a tick to 0).

not_editable.label: Flash script
not_editable.doc: The colour script of a screen flash
